name: billing_account_id
description: Essential for multi-account cost consolidation, organizational financial governance, and segregating spend across different legal entities or business units.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Perform high-level spend analysis to identify which specific Google Cloud products are the primary cost drivers for prioritization of optimization efforts.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Critical for rate card analysis, unit price verification, and mapping line items to list prices for deep-dive resource optimization.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Helps analysts identify specific resource classes, machine types, or storage tiers to provide granular rightsizing or tiering recommendations.

name: usage_start_time
description: Analyze cost spikes at a granular hourly level to identify batch jobs, peak usage periods, or idle resources during non-business hours.

name: usage_end_time
description: Used to calculate usage duration for ephemeral workloads and verify billing cycle alignment for precise cost-per-hour calculations.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary dimension for cost allocation, departmental chargeback/showback, and identifying "zombie" or "orphan" projects with no active ownership.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Enhance visibility in reports for non-technical stakeholders by using friendly project naming conventions.

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Automate cost attribution to specific cost centers, environments, or business units based on project-level metadata.

fields.name: ancestry_numbers
fields.description: Aggregate costs across entire folders or business units to enable hierarchical spend analysis and department-wide chargebacks.

name: labels
description: The most granular mechanism for cost attribution; used to allocate spend to specific applications, microservices, environments (prod/dev), or owners.

name: system_labels
description: Analyze reservation utilization (used vs. unused capacity) and perform rightsizing analysis based on machine configurations.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Identify high-spend regions and evaluate cost-saving opportunities by migrating workloads to cheaper geographic locations.

name: tags
description: Implement standardized, non-mutable cost allocation and policy-driven governance that cannot be bypassed by users.

name: export_time
description: Monitor data freshness and ensure the recommendation engine is analyzing the most recent available billing cycle data.

name: cost
description: Used to track gross spend, calculate burn rates, and serve as the baseline metric for cost-based KPIs and ROI calculations.

name: currency
description: Handle multi-currency reporting and normalize global spend into a single functional currency for unified financial views.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Measure consumption volume independently of price to detect resource bloat, inefficiency, or usage-based anomalies.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Standardize usage metrics across different services to calculate unit economics and validate technical architecture designs.

name: credits
description: Evaluate the effectiveness of savings programs and calculate "Net Cost" by subtracting credits from the gross cost.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Primary field for reconciling exported BigQuery data with official monthly financial statements and tracking budget adherence over time.

name: cost_type
description: Filter between actual resource consumption and administrative costs like taxes or financial adjustments for precise unit economics analysis.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Track recovery of funds from SLA violations or audit financial corrections to ensure billing accuracy.

name: cost_at_list
description: Compare list price vs. effective price to quantify the total savings generated by FinOps negotiations and discount programs.
